title: (MIST) — Granular Feedback Processor
summary: Simplos-inspired granular processor. Grains re-play the recent audio with a tight, adaptive feedback loop (the delay tracks the grain size), so the loop stays immediate and responsive instead of smearing. A pre/post feedback blend morphs a dry grain cloud into an airy spatial delay.

params.size: Grain length in ms. Also sets how far back the feedback loop reaches — short = tight/immediate, long = loose/spacious.
params.amount: Window decay shape: 0 = sharp linear tail, 1 = smooth rounded tail.
params.spike: Grain attack sharpness: low = soft/airy onset, high = sharp/percussive onset.
params.blur: Random jitter on grain pitch and read position. 0 = locked/clean, high = smeared/chorused.
params.pitch: Grain playback pitch in semitones, -36..+36. Feedback compounds pitch shift each pass — keep FB low when pitch is far from 0 or it spirals.
params.fb_pre: Short feedback tap — feeds a tight loop back in for a thicker, denser grain texture.
params.fb_post: Longer feedback tap (4x the pre tap) — feeds a looser loop back in for sustain/wash; with fb_pre it becomes a spatial-delay instrument.
params.width: Stereo width of the grain cloud (mid/side).
params.freeze: Stop writing new input into the buffer — grains keep cycling through what's already captured (infinite hold).
params.reverse: Grains read backwards through the buffer.

tips: Dry shimmer cloud: Size ~85ms, Spike ~0.6, FB Pre/Post 0, Amount ~0.45.
Sustaining bloom: Size ~200ms, Amount ~0.85, FB Post ~0.9 — thick and holds after the input stops.
Spatial delay: FB Pre ~0.25, FB Post ~0.6-0.8, Blur ~0.2, Width high — airy, echoing.
Freeze a moment: turn Freeze on while playing to hold the last captured buffer indefinitely.
Pitched feedback (+/- 7-12 st) compounds each pass — keep FB Post low (~0.2) or it runs away fast.
